output.final_answer: Based on official population figures within city limits, the populations are approximately 9.09 million for London, 3.69 million for Berlin, and 2.05 million for Paris. Among these three, Berlin and Paris are the two cities closest in size, with a difference of approximately 1.6 to 1.7 million residents. Please note that these figures refer to administrative city limits; if metropolitan area definitions are used, the rankings and relative gaps change significantly, with some data sources placing the Paris metropolitan area as the largest of the three. Sources: Wikipedia (List of European cities by population within city limits), World Population Review (Europe Cities by Population 2026), and Statista (Largest European cities 2025).
